name: name-with-digits
about: A campaign's name carries digits (a year, a radius) that are the advertiser's words, not figures.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns spent $219.50 and delivered 5 leads at $43.90 each across 11,850 impressions.
points: CDL-A 2026 Joliet 75mi drove all 5 leads of the day on $153.40 spent, with a cost per lead of $30.68 and a click rate of 1.4% from 8,800 impressions and 120 clicks.
Team drivers I-80 spent $66.10 across 3,050 impressions and 30 clicks at a 1.0% click rate, but brought no leads yet, so there is no cost per lead to report.
Month-to-date through 2026-11 with 28 days left, Meta spend stands at $487.00.
The 2026-09-21 cohort is mature at 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 qualified (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort is also mature at 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 qualified (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads with 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost, but it is too young to judge rates yet.
